description: E-mail for Tharga Team — reading over IMAP, sending over SMTP and MIME handling, shared by support cases and any other mailbox a host keeps.

The base MSBuild SDK of every Snail library and server: the build rules, the analyzers by category so a newer .NET SDK adds advice instead of breaking the build, the agreed rules as warnings, dependency audit and deterministic, source-linked builds. Snail.Sdk.Library and Snail.Sdk.Mcp build on it.

The owner's code rules as Roslyn analyzers: unpack long LINQ chains, create before returning, a blank line before the answer, no comments inside members, English only, no pattern names, no types in names, booleans that ask, no `this.`, keyword types. Referenced by Snail.Sdk.

The MSBuild SDK of a Snail library: Snail.Sdk, plus the public API kept in PublicAPI.*.txt so any change shows in the diff, validation against the last published package, native compatibility declared, and symbol packages.

The MSBuild SDK of a Snail MCP server: Snail.Sdk, plus a dotnet tool of the McpServer kind described by three properties (native, transport, container), the hosting libraries implicitly, the tool reference generated from the server itself, and publishing into ~/.s3l-mcp/<name>/<date-time>.<commit>/…

What every Snail MCP server starts from: the empty host with log lines on stderr and the heap compacted when the server goes quiet, the MCP SDK's JSON options with a server's generated types put first, settings read from its settings file and its prefixed environment variables, the folders it keeps…
One Snail MCP server for every session of the machine: the empty web host on a loopback address, the MCP SDK's Streamable HTTP transport with a session per client, and no browser let through.

Starts a Snail MCP server under test the way a client starts it — the dll beside the tests, or the published native program a variable names — so a contract test calls every tool over stdio against either build.
The templates of a Snail library (dotnet new s3l-lib) and a Snail MCP server (dotnet new s3l-mcp), built on Snail.Sdk of the same release.

A .NET client for local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM), built on Microsoft.Extensions.AI: server discovery, streaming chat with separate reasoning, and errors and timeouts suited to local hardware.
